sloka: नैते धर्मं विजानन्ति राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः ।ध्रुवं मां प्रातराशार्थे राक्षसः कल्पयिष्यति ।। ५.२४.३४।।।।
transliteration: naite dharmaṁ vijānanti rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ ।dhruvaṁ māṁ prātarāśārthe rākṣasaḥ kalpayiṣyati ।। 5.24.34।।।।

translations.english: 'O Sita offer your love to Ravana, adore him and be happy. Give up this continuous dejection. Enjoy all pleasures along with the king of demons.
